# 1 Enoch Chapter 57 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**1** Then I looked, and there were vast companies of angels — whole armies made of luminous clouds — streaming out from that place. Light and dew-drops rained down on them as they moved, with still more armies of light advancing behind them.

**2** After that I saw these same armies carrying a golden crown with them; the company had the look of human forms. I turned to the angel of peace who was with me and asked, "What is this?"

**3** He told me: "These are going to the children of the elect and the righteous. They will inherit everything you see. Their portion will be peace across the face of the earth — they will be planted deep in it. And these armies will descend from heaven; you will hear the sound of their host, and they will fill the world. The heavenly army will come down and take its stand before them."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Ch. 57 provides the positive counterpart to ch. 56's armies of punishment. The 'golden crown' carried by angels for the children of the righteous anticipates the crown-imagery of Revelation 2-4. The image of the elect being 'planted' in the earth echoes Amos 9:15.*
